title: Cyber Safe India: advisory on task-based job fraud
license_note: Government of India public information; reuse subject to PIB website policy and attribution. Confirm page-specific terms before public redistribution.
excerpt: The advisory describes task-based job scams promoted through online messaging platforms, including WhatsApp and Telegram. Victims may receive small initial commissions and then be encouraged to deposit larger amounts; later, funds may be frozen or unavailable. Verify payment recipients before transferring money and report suspected cyber financial fraud through official Indian reporting channels.

title: Job Scams
license_note: FTC-produced material is generally public domain under FTC website policy, excluding third-party content; retain attribution and verify exclusions.
excerpt: Job scams can involve requests to pay for a job, work-from-home offers that promise easy money, fake checks, reshipping schemes, or paid placement services that overpromise results. Research the employer and be cautious when an offer requires money or financial transactions before you have verified the job.

title: That job offer text is probably a scam
license_note: FTC-produced material is generally public domain under FTC website policy, excluding third-party content; retain attribution and verify exclusions.
excerpt: Unexpected messages claiming to offer a job may be a way to draw people into scams. Warning patterns described include unsolicited recruiter texts, fake-check schemes, task scams, and attempts to move conversations to messaging apps. An unsolicited message alone is not proof of fraud; verify the recruiter and employer independently.

title: How to spot and avoid task scams
license_note: FTC-produced material is generally public domain under FTC website policy, excluding third-party content; retain attribution and verify exclusions.
excerpt: Task scams may promise earnings for simple online activities such as rating or liking content. The displayed balance or small early payout may be used to build trust, followed by a demand to deposit money—sometimes cryptocurrency—to unlock tasks or withdraw supposed earnings. Do not pay money to get paid.

title: Scam alert: Job recruitment scams
license_note: Scamwatch content may be reused under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia subject to stated exclusions; attribute publisher and check page-specific third-party material.
excerpt: Recruitment scams may involve people impersonating recruiters or employers, pressure to act quickly, and offers that lead to requests for payment or other suspicious steps. Some task or side-hustle scams use messaging platforms and require victims to top up an account. Verify the role and recruiter through independently obtained contact details.

publisher: Scamwatch, Australian Competition and Consumer Commission
title: Scam alert: Jobs and ‘side hustle’ scams
license_note: Scamwatch content may be reused under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia subject to stated exclusions; attribute publisher and check page-specific third-party material.
excerpt: Job and side-hustle scams can advertise easy earnings and then ask people to pay upfront, deposit cryptocurrency, or act under pressure. Treat promised returns and requests to pay in order to receive earnings as warning signs, and independently verify the business and opportunity.

title: Advisory on overcharging by agents for overseas recruitment, offering fake overseas jobs and illegal recruitment
license_note: Official Government of India advisory. Reuse/licensing terms were not confirmed in the research notes; retain attribution and review terms before redistribution.
excerpt: The advisory warns that unregistered recruitment agents may cheat job seekers with fake overseas job offers and excessive charges. Such agents may advertise or contact applicants through social media, WhatsApp, text messages, or other channels, while providing few verifiable details. Verify the recruiting agent and the foreign employer through official channels before paying fees, handing over documents, or travelling for employment.
